acceptance.J_reevaluation: every one of 320 saved expected-trajectory worlds; exact actions, abs utility error <= 2e-12 * (1 + abs(scientific J utility)); preserve all descriptive diagnostics
acceptance.all_actions: exact equality, on canonical and query nodes; no near-tie exemption
acceptance.all_legal_Q: absolute error <= 2e-12 * (1 + abs(reference_Q)), on canonical and query nodes
acceptance.failure_policy: retain all errors and measured costs, keep the planned denominator 320, no resampling, dropping worlds, editing protocol, changing tolerances, or changing frozen science files
acceptance.frozen_query_table: regenerated rows must exactly match saved scientific table SHA256 before export
acceptance.graph_identity: actual request bytes SHA256 bound to native output and exporter manifest

graph.argmax: first legal action using strict greater-than updates
graph.arithmetic: start each continuation Q at positive zero; in input branch order, if probability != 0, add probability * ((V_child + reward) - fee); no FMA, no reassociation

branches.fee: nonnegative actual f64 successor charges minus source charges

graph.order: all canonical nodes sorted by descending tick and canonical Markov key; then representative query nodes in the same order; all successors refer to strictly earlier canonical nodes
graph.source_attestation_scope: Python exporter binds the original source/checkpoint/public schedule to graph bytes. Native generic graph solver authenticates only its actual request and execution; it does not independently authenticate checkpoint physics.
graph.zero_probability_branches: retained in input; skipped by solver exactly as original Oracle.q

mathematical_reason_for_two_layers: Frozen Oracle.q evaluates immediate fee differences using the enumerated representative's actual accumulated charges, but recursive cached V uses Oracle._state(key) with zero charges. These states are mathematically equivalent but their f64 fee differences can differ near exact action ties. Two DAG layers preserve the existing arithmetic before results are inspected; they are not a new policy.
native_execution_precondition: Native owner freezes its exact compiled Rust source/build identity and complete MCP execution resource budget before reading native corpus outputs; graph export does not start native execution.

resource_caps.costs: full export/import/startup/write cost, native process and RPC cost, comparison and complete J replay cost reported separately; source retrieval/build costs separately retained
resource_caps.native_phase_budget_scope: owner to freeze process/RPC cap and complete outer process measurement before execution
resource_caps.storage: deterministic gzip, ten fit/domain aggregates; split compressed bytes deterministically into 479000-byte parts when required

rpc.request_hashes: Exporter hashes exact canonical-Python argument bytes. Native separately returns a typed-Serde canonical request SHA256. Executor retains original argument SHA and native response identity; the two different serialization hashes are never conflated.

states.q: exactly six f64-or-null entries, null iff illegal

scope: Engineering migration replay of all 320 already-scored TEST worlds. No new scientific candidate, holdout, efficacy qualification, optimization search, or change to the frozen scientific protocol.
